review.evidence: Wave 2 local-control review at MANTRA block 18558336, hash 0xde0552c53e1cf32ae1b2e8514645c195195dea21a1a47decc363b0a5708132c4, timestamp 2026-10-03T23:46:31Z. Complete explorer RoleGranted/RoleRevoked histories from block zero through this pin yielded four token grants, no token revocations, five SwapFacility grants and one SwapFacility revocation; hasRole at the same pin confirms every surviving holder and the revoked administrator. The token's three source-defined roles are DEFAULT_ADMIN, FREEZE_MANAGER and YIELD_RECIPIENT_MANAGER; current holders are respectively 0x3b49208e7e831b29ea2e93fb09f315f414fd7343; 0x9cb81ad5423e0ca22d3e3af3004c85d865b70efe and 0x363c256d368277bbfaf6eaf65bee123a7adba464; and 0x50651b740e5d7b6c7c063c8618ccfc13a24b4874. Facility source defines DEFAULT_ADMIN, M_SWAPPER and PAUSER: current holders are respectively 0xe5acad215fb9cff7823ad7d81fdd09615b93f41f; 0x36f586a30502ae3afb555b8aa4dcc05d233c2ece and 0xd925c84b55e4e44a53749ff5f2a5a13f63d128fd; and 0xf2f1acbe0ba726fee8d75f3e32900526874740bb. The latter's earlier DEFAULT_ADMIN grant was revoked. Facility proxy, implementation, immutable ProxyAdmin and its 2-of-3 Safe owner are resolved in the additional control; pinned Safe singleton storage is 0xfb1bffc9d739b8d520daf37df666da4c687191ea. The token ProxyAdmin owner's pinned code is empty; exact ProxyAdmin onlyOwner upgradeAndCall contains no delay, an adverse zero-delay replacement power rather than an unknown protective safeguard. Verified local token issuance remains only immutable-SwapFacility wrap/unwrap and claimYield: wrap transfers matching M before minting; claimYield is bounded by M custody minus existing supply. Facility permissions gate paths and recipients but do not create deposit-free M; the immutable registrar/M dependency is upstream M authority, not a new local mint path. Earlier unresolved role census, upgrade-delay and facility-reach questions are answered by these reads and verified code. Identified signers' organizational independence and key custody remain separately scoped non-disclosures, not proven safeguards. Prior block-18531313 custody/supply reconciliation and block-18540330 token Safe observations retain their own dates and are not claimed re-read. Local reconciliation=continuous describes only parent-token custody accounting, not upstream reserve assurance; supervision=unknown remains unchanged. Scoped incident search includes current mantraUSD security disclosures and the primary 2026-08-28 MANTRA-chain postmortem: the native-accounting exploit debited native MANTRA, did not create tokens or debit application contracts, and compromised no administrative/governance/multisig keys. No local mantraUSD unauthorized-issuance incident was located. No transaction was sent and no executionScope certificate or governed-issuance qualification is claimed.
